## UserInterface.renderPage() method

Renders a ReactNode in the main content area.

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderPage(node: ReactNode): void;
```

## Remarks

RAM cost: 0 GB

On the left side of the UI, the sidebar contains shortcuts to game features (Terminal, Script Editor, City, etc.). When clicking a sidebar item, the feature is rendered on the right side of the UI. This space is the main content area.

For example, when you click the "City" button in the sidebar, the locations in that city are rendered in the main content area.

This function effectively switches to a new custom "page", as if you had navigated via the sidebar. Calling it again replaces the contents of the page.
